name: The Bag

magic.curse: Something lives in the bag. Each Long Rest, a 1 on a d6 means it slipped out in the night and caused mayhem close by. (Reference only; the game does not roll it yet.) It dies for good only to someone holding a child's toy, and then the bag is merely a bag.

summary: A satchel that holds 500 lb and weighs 5, with a Lurker in the Dark inside. It is cursed.
text: A shabby satchel with a clasp like an eye that moves when you look away. It opens onto a space far bigger than itself, like a Bag of Holding (500 pounds, always weighing 5, with the same dangers if it is overloaded or torn). It attunes to the first creature to touch it at once, ending one of that creature's attunements if it had three. Reference-only, not run by the game: three times between dusks, a Bonus Action lets the thing inside claw out (+7 to hit, 1d10+4 piercing, grappling a creature on a hit, escape DC 14). The lurker inside truly dies only at the hands of someone holding a child's toy; when it does, the bag turns into an ordinary satchel.
